maddeler.e:
استؤصلت (form X)
# اُسْتُؤْصِلْتُ (ustuʔṣiltu) /us.tuʔ.sˤil.tu/: first-person singular past passive of اِسْتَأْصَلَ (istaʔṣala)
# اُسْتُؤْصِلْتَ (ustuʔṣilta) /us.tuʔ.sˤil.ta/: second-person masculine singular past passive of اِسْتَأْصَلَ (istaʔṣala)
# اُسْتُؤْصِلْتِ (ustuʔṣilti) /us.tuʔ.sˤil.ti/: second-person feminine singular past passive of اِسْتَأْصَلَ (istaʔṣala)
# اُسْتُؤْصِلَتْ (ustuʔṣilat)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
